faq.a: No food is included. We offer cotton candy and drinks as an add-on. Outside food and drink is allowed if you wish to cater yourself. Fridge and freezer available for your own cake and ice cream.
Fly High grip socks are required ($3). Non Fly High grip socks are subject to approval. Normal socks are not permitted.

faq.q: Is there a deposit for parties?
What if our party runs late?
faq.a: $25 fee for every 10 minutes that table is still occupied after official party end time.

faq.q: Does the base party price cover everyone?
faq.a: Base price does NOT represent total price for party. All guests that are jumping must be paid for in addition to base price: $16 per jumper 6+, $12 per jumper 5 and under.

Ages 6+: 1 hour $16, 2 hours $24, 3 hours $32 (with free grip socks and small fountain drink). Ages 3-5: 1 hour $12, 2 hours $18, 3 hours $23 (with free grip socks and drink). Ages 2 and under $4 per hour. Parent access $10 per hour.
Monthly memberships with two hour jump time: ages 6 and up $34.95, ages 3-5 $24.95. $10 registration fee, 3-month contract (non-refundable), recurring credit card payment only.

Monday Family Night 4-9 PM 20% off ticket price; Tuesday BOGO hour; Wednesday Buddy Night 2nd ticket 1/2 off; Thursday College Night $4 off with school ID and 50% off fountain drinks 4-9 PM; Friday Flight Night 7-10 pm for $23. Specials may not be valid on holidays / no school days.

faq.q: Do you have Parents and Tots or sensory times?
faq.a: Parents and Tots (school year only): Mon & Fri from 10, Tues-Thurs 12-2 PM, 2 hours for $8 per child 5 & under with paying parent ($10). Sensory Bounce Fridays 10 AM to Noon, $6 per jumper, 1 caretaker free.
10% off regular jump admission with ID. Cannot be combined with memberships, daily specials, parties, group events and concessions.
Summer: Monday-Thursday 10 am to 9 pm, Friday-Saturday 10 am to 10 pm, Sunday 10 am to 8 pm. School year hours differ Tuesday-Thursday (12 pm to 9 pm).

4th of July: close at 6pm. Oct 31: close at 4pm. Christmas Eve: close at 4 pm. Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and Easter: closed. Check our Facebook/Instagram for unexpected closures due to facility rentals.
